title: dotsteward review.json
description: What the last run of a command leaves for a person or an agent: <state>/review.json (schema_version 1), written by dotsteward_cli.report. It stays on the machine and is never published. An item names what is needed with its code; the fields around the code depend on it.

run.description: The name of the run; <state>/runs/<command>/<run>.json is its report.

exit_code.description: The exit code of the run (docs/exit-codes.md).
